battery_device.title: Battery care — {device}
battery_device.description:
Keeps an old iPad's battery between the start and stop levels by switching its charger plug, instead of charging 24/7. The panel reports its battery even with the screen off. If reports stop, the charger is turned on as a fail-safe.

Battery now: {battery}% · status: {state}

data.charger: Charger plug (switch / light / input_boolean powering the charger)

editor.title: Dashboard editor
editor.description:
Design your panels' layouts in the editor, then press **Deploy** to send a profile to a panel.

**[Open the dashboard editor]({url})**

It runs inside Home Assistant using your login (admin only) and isn't added to the sidebar. Bookmark it if you like, or reach it from here or from a panel's device page (Visit).
